Implementation complete in `.rebar/worktrees/impl-f5f5` (base `origin/main` @ `9bd1d5f8124`). All 4 plan steps applied as written; 2 new tests added.

**Cites re-measured against the current tree** (plan cited `38f8587f65d`; main has moved). The structural facts held — `_ENTRIES` was still empty, `_activation_map` unchanged, `overlay.py` still had no `logging` import. Only the line numbers drifted; the warn landed in `_effective_routing_cached` right after `overlay = _load_overlay(rr_arg)` / `if overlay is not None:` exactly as planned.

**AC results**

| AC | Result |
|---|---|
| AC1 `REGISTRY[...].remove_in` | PASS — prints `v1.0.0` |
| AC2 new tests + `test_no_raw_deprecation_emissions` | PASS — 39 passed (`test_criteria_overlay.py` + `test_deprecation_registry.py`) |
| AC3 `git grep -i "single.pass"` on the 2 files | PASS — exit 1, no output |
| AC4 `git grep -c "logs a deprecation warning"` | PASS — `1` |
| AC5 mechanism-delta | **DEVIATION — see below** |
| AC6 `make verify` | pending (queued behind 25a4) |

**AC5 is a latent-AC defect, not a regression.** The AC reads "reports `new=0`". The script reports `active=650 new=27 increased=0 stale=0` and exits 0, because all 27 `new` entries carry in-tree `# mechanism-ok:` admissions. Measured the same command on a pristine throwaway worktree at `origin/main`: **identical** — `active=650 new=27 increased=0 stale=0`, rc 0. So this change adds zero mechanisms, which is what AC5 was written to establish; its literal `new=0` phrasing was never true on this tree. The gate's real pass condition is rc 0 with every new entry admitted, and that holds.

This is the 6th confirmed member of the latent-AC class (an AC pinning an exact count measured at planning time): `dc42`, `db2c` AC9, `25a4` AC8, `a018`, `19ba` AC5, now `f5f5` AC5.

**Side-effect checked:** the 3 existing list-form fixtures in `test_criteria_overlay.py` now emit the new warning. No test asserts warning-free output, and all 39 pass.

**Docstring rewrite checked against its pins:** `test_code_review_assemble.py::test_assemble_does_not_import_single_pass_route` and `test_code_review_ws4.py::test_single_pass_route_is_retired` both assert over the AST/import graph, not the docstring text, so the rewrite does not touch them. `git grep -n single_pass -- src` now returns nothing at all.
